translations.web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
translations.bsb: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
translations.kjv: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
translations.asv: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.
